The '''Glory-class dark trooper''' was a [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark trooper]] variant used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Equipment==
Glory-class were primarily used as [[City/Legends|city]] guards, and relied on a wide variety of weapons. They used standard [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifles]], [[EE-3 carbine rifle/Legends|EE-3 carbine rifles]], [[DXR6 heavy carbine]]s, and, possibly, [[T-21 light repeating blaster/Legends|T-21 light repeating blasters]]. These [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] were heavily [[Armor/Legends|armored]] and were very dangerous with any [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] they had in their possession. Their appearance struck awe and fear in any [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] they encountered. The troopers were armored more than most stormtroopers. Many rebels fled in fear when they saw [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]], knowing they could fire and wreak havoc any second. One ''Glory''-class dark trooper was [[GK-121]].
